# Shi Zhang Studio

> Independent healthcare & technical presentation consultancy (Central, Hong Kong, UTC+8). Shi Zhang has 17+ years preparing, structuring and reviewing project proposals, data tables and conference/defense presentations, and now designs hospital quality-improvement (QC Story / QC circle / PDCA / A3) decks, QI and patient-safety conference posters (A0, 48 x 36 in, ePoster) and medical-education slides from client-approved materials. White-label production for consultancies and presentation agencies is available. Clients supply and approve all clinical content; every delivery gets a separate quality-review pass. Scope and a flat estimate are agreed by email before work starts.
